label: Wren Twig
prompt: Correct the LINE GEOMETRY and printed-ink character of this same OWN whole wren/twig material prototype. Preserve the recognizable whole wren pose, two feet, beak, eye, cocked tail, curved twig, two leaves, flat single petrol-blue ink #20536A and transparent alpha. Replace ALL regular diagonal diamond-mesh/net/lace areas on breast, head and wing with broad elaborate TRUE GUILLOCHE SPIROGRAPH ROSETTE linework: nested offset multi-lobed circular/elliptical epitrochoid curves that oscillate in rounded petal-like interlacing lobes, creating precise low-frequency curved interference bands. The breast contains ONE large elliptical multi-lobed rosette following its rounded silhouette; the folded wing contains a narrower nested multi-lobed oval rosette with visible open fan pockets; tail uses nested oscillating fan arcs. It must read unmistakably as flat engine-engraved intaglio printing, visibly different from tied bobbin lace or any woven thread. No diagonal warp/weft lattice, fabric/fibres/thread, circular stitch knots, raised wire, fuzzy lines, shaded mesh or paper-cut filigree. Single matte uniformly flat blue ink lines with restrained dry print bite. Broader separated rosette arcs readable at85px, not a chaotic nest of hair-thin lines. No realistic feather hatching or 3D metal. Keep whole natural coherent bird anatomy and ample true transparent margins. No panel, paper rectangle, background, shadow, lettering, symbols or UI. Preserve the bird silhouette; change only the internal printed geometry and flat-ink material.
processing: Uniform whole-original containment within1100px on1200px transparent square. No crop, recolour, alpha cleanup or creative raster/code edits; app adds its own Fit padding.

references.purpose: Own initial whole wren, correcting only mesh-like geometry to broad flat printed rosettes.
